incoterms.title: Incoterms
incoterms.subtitle: We work with all major trade terms

fob.title: FOB
fob.description: Free On Board — seller delivers goods onto the vessel. Buyer bears shipping costs and risk from that point.

cif.title: CIF
cif.description: Cost, Insurance & Freight — seller covers costs and insurance to destination port. Buyer takes risk at origin port.

exw.title: EXW
exw.description: Ex Works — buyer collects goods from seller's premises and bears all costs and risks.

fcl.title: FCL (Full Container Load)
fcl.description: Dedicated 20' or 40' containers for larger orders.

lcl.title: LCL (Less than Container Load)
lcl.description: Shared container space for smaller shipments.

reefer.title: Reefer Containers
reefer.description: Temperature-controlled containers for perishable FMCG goods.

process.title: From Source to Shipment —
process.subtitle: A four-stage quality and compliance protocol ensures every container leaving our network meets target-market requirements.
process.step1Desc: Every manufacturer is audited for facility hygiene, certifications, and traceability before onboarding.
process.step2Desc: Pre-shipment lab testing for microbial, chemical, and physical safety parameters where required.
process.step3Desc: COA, COO, health, and halal certificates verified for each shipment and target market.
process.step4Desc: Full export documentation, labelling, and customs paperwork tailored to destination regulations.
